summary: Iteration 16 end-to-end verification of the LEGACY bank-record → withdrawal blocker bug fix. Backend: 16/16 new pytest cases pass (per-field 400s, phone format, GET /api/bank shape with is_complete+missing_fields, legacy-doc simulation via direct MongoDB unset, withdrawal blocked with the exact new spec message, and withdrawal proceeds when complete). Iteration 15 regression suite also re-run (26/27 → 27/27 after updating one stale assertion string). Frontend: 3-scenario UI tour (LEGACY, NO-BANK, COMPLETE) — every assertion passed: warning banner text, MISSING badges + rose border, disabled Submit/Save gating, and post-save banner disappearance.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py grew further (~1400+ lines). REQUIRED_BANK_FIELDS + _bank_missing_fields belong in a bank router module; splitting into routers/{auth,bank,withdrawals,admin,kyc}.py is now overdue.

In server.py L1201, the per-field error message uses f'{f.replace("_"," ").title()} is required' which produces the ugly literal 'Ifsc is required' rather than 'IFSC is required'. Cosmetic — front-end already shows the correct 'IFSC' via its own label constants, so unlikely to be user-visible. Consider a small label-map for admin/logging clarity.

_bank_missing_fields marks phone_number missing when format-invalid. That's the desired behaviour, but the raw returned bank still echoes the invalid phone string on GET /api/bank — front-end BankDetailsCard shows it in the input while flagging MISSING. Acceptable UX (user sees + fixes their own bad value), just noting it.
BankDetailsCard.jsx still uses .slice(-10) client-side normalisation (same finding as iter 15) — server enforces exact 10, so safe.

rca_of_the_issue: Root cause (pre-fix): POST /api/withdrawals previously only checked `if not bank: raise 400 'Add bank details first'`. Since phone_number was added as required in iteration 15, users who saved bank details BEFORE that migration have a doc lacking the phone_number key entirely — the pre-fix check saw a doc existed and let the withdrawal through, producing incomplete admin snapshots. Fix: a new REQUIRED_BANK_FIELDS + _bank_missing_fields(bank) helper computes missing keys (also flags format-invalid phone). Both POST /api/withdrawals and GET /api/bank use it — the former blocks with a unified message, the latter exposes is_complete + missing_fields so the FE can gate the Submit button and show per-field MISSING badges. Legacy data is not auto-migrated (spec-compliant): raw fields returned untouched; users must enter their real phone. Verified end-to-end via direct-Mongo $unset simulation + full backend pytest + Playwright UI tour of legacy/nobank/complete scenarios.
